summary.name: SocratiQ
summary.one_liner: SocratiQ is an AI-facilitated teaching and learning platform for schools, universities and independent learners, with teacher-assignable curricula, AI tutor personas, and an interactive markdown notebook.
use_cases: Designing and assigning curriculums to students
Independent or homeschool group learning with AI facilitation
Assessing student mastery with quizzes and essays
Sharing and remixing published learning explorations
summary.what_it_does: The page describes SocratiQ as a platform where teachers can build active curricula and assign them to students, and where students explore topics with AI facilitators that have distinct personas. Assessment includes topical quizzes, essays, and mastery and wellness reports with qualitative feedback. The Interactive Notebook offers a markdown editor with side-by-side preview, color-coded and hierarchical notes, auto save, and offline support. Other features listed include roster import, teacher roles, group admin controls, and publishing or forking shared "explorations". The page says the platform is built around standards-aligned curricula and a privacy-focused design, though it gives few technical specifics.
notable: AI facilitators with distinct personas tailored to subject and student needs
Interactive notebook with markdown editor, side-by-side preview and color-coded notes
Teacher-assignable curricula with mastery and wellness reports
Shared publishing, forking and remixing of learning explorations
caveats: Pricing is not published; the page asks schools to book a call for a tailored solution
Several programs such as hiring and early access are listed as 'register to know when we launch', suggesting some features are not yet released
Listed as paid in the directory entry
